title: Board-Approved Cafeteria Price Schedule 2026-27 — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The prices below are what a School Nutrition Services Meal Account is charged at the cafeteria register for each kind of purchase, by meal status and by campus pricing level.

## Reimbursable meal charges by meal status (USD)

| Meal status | Breakfast, elementary or early childhood campus | Lunch, elementary or early childhood campus | Breakfast, middle or high school campus | Lunch, middle or high school campus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status | 1.85 | 3.10 | 2.10 | 3.45 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | 0.30 | 0.40 | 0.30 | 0.40 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | 0.30 | 0.40 | 0.30 | 0.40 |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The first two price columns are the elementary breakfast charge and the elementary lunch charge; the last two are the secondary breakfast charge and the secondary lunch charge.

## Prices the same for every status

| Item | Price (USD) |
|---|---|
| Second (non-reimbursable) breakfast or lunch on the same day, the same at every campus and status (the second-meal price) | 4.25 |
| Carton of milk bought on its own (the milk-only price) | 0.75 |
| Reimbursable breakfast or lunch at a Community Eligibility Provision (CEP) campus (the CEP meal charge) | 0.00 |

## Campuses and pricing levels

The campuses operating the Community Eligibility Provision for school year 2026-27, where reimbursable breakfast and lunch are served at no charge to every student, are Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary and Hollis Middle School; the list is the same for every status.

| Campus | Pricing level |
|---|---|
| Sunflower Early Childhood Center | elementary (early childhood centers price as elementary) |
| Alder Springs Elementary | elementary |
| Bluebonnet Trail Elementary | elementary |
| Cypress Hollow Elementary | elementary (CEP campus) |
| Live Oak Elementary | elementary |
| Pecan Grove Elementary | elementary (CEP campus) |
| Hollis Middle School | middle (CEP campus) |
| Ridgecrest Middle School | middle |
| Calloway Creek High School | high |
| Mesquite Ridge High School | high |

Middle and high school campuses both price at the secondary charges.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical purchases)

- A student on Paid Meal Status at Live Oak Elementary is charged 1.85 for a reimbursable breakfast and 3.10 for a reimbursable lunch.
- The same student, if moved to Ridgecrest Middle School, is charged 2.10 and 3.45.
- A student on Reduced-Price Meal Status at any non-CEP campus is charged 0.30 for breakfast and 0.40 for lunch.
- Any student at Hollis Middle School is charged 0.00 for a reimbursable breakfast or lunch, but still pays 4.25 for a second meal and 0.75 for milk bought alone.
